text:
sasha: heads-up — mkdocs linkcheck failing on CI for a few internal links, looks anchor-related. noticed it in /guides/auth.md -> /reference/sdk links.

docs-bot: linkcheck summary: 2 broken fragments, sample:
```
Broken fragment: /guides/auth/#token-format not found (linked from /reference/sdk/#token-format)
Check logged at: ci/linkcheck/2026-03-20-14:22
```

eli: which heading is that? can you paste the heading text from the source file?

sasha: sure — in guides/auth.md the heading is:
```
### Token format 🔑
```
but in the SDK reference we link to `#token-format`. seems like mkdocs slugification is keeping the emoji in the generated id for that build, so the generated anchor becomes something like `token-format-🔑` and the plain `#token-format` in the reference misses.

maya: ok that makes sense — emoji in headings can produce inconsistent slugs depending on slugifier/version. two practical fixes:
1) add explicit ids to headings using attr_list: `### Token format {#token-format}` and enable `attr_list` in mkdocs.yml so the anchor is stable.
2) or strip/escape emojis from headings (less ideal for UX).

example mkdocs.yml snippet to enable attr_list:
```yaml
markdown_extensions:
  - attr_list
```

sasha: +1 for explicit ids, quick and minimal.

arun: i can open a PR to add the explicit id on guides/auth.md and also add attr_list to mkdocs.yml. i'll add a short note in the PR description explaining why (linkcheck failure + emoji slug mismatch) and include the linkcheck log. i'll use branch `docs/anchor-token-format-fix`.

eli: sweet — can you also grep for other headings with emoji or parens around function names? i ran into `list_models()` -> anchors with parentheses sometimes get turned into `list_models%28%29` depending on the slugifier.

sasha: good call. found a few candidates in /reference and /examples. quick list (not exhaustive):
- reference/sdk.md: `list_models()`
- guides/deploy.md: `Deploy (on-prem)`
- guides/auth.md: `Token format 🔑` (the one arun will fix)

maya: for function names with parens we have two options: escape the link to the generated anchor, or give the heading an explicit id as well: `### list_models() {#list_models}` — explicit ids win.

jupiter-ci: FYI CI currently marks linkcheck as failed for that job. after arun's PR we should be able to re-run linkcheck job only.

arun: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234 — includes: add `{#token-format}` to guides/auth.md, add `attr_list` to mkdocs.yml, and a short grep+fix for two other headings. CI will run linkcheck.

docs-bot: PR check started — linkcheck job queued.

eli: quick review planned. small request: add a one-line note in docs/CONTRIBUTING.md about adding explicit ids when headings include emoji or special chars so future authors know the pattern.

arun: will add that in the same PR (one-line update).

sasha: thanks all. once CI passes, let's cherry-pick to the 2.1 branch if possible (we ship docs updates with the 2.1 patch).

maya: note for future: we should add a pre-commit hook or a small lint that warns about emoji in H1-H3. filing a follow-up ticket.

eli: i can start that ticket after this lands.

sasha: awesome. thanks @arun — ping when CI is green and i'll do the cherry-pick. :thumbsup:
